scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@nodriver/protocol && npm run build --workspace=@nodriver/runtime-js && npm run build --workspace=@nodriver/api && npm run build --workspace=@nodriver/runtime-native
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@nodriver/protocol-codegen && npm run test --workspace=@nodriver/runtime-js && npm run test --workspace=@nodriver/api && npm run test --workspace=@nodriver/runtime-native
scripts.conformance:network: npm run build --workspace=@nodriver/runtime-js && tsc -p packages/api/tsconfig.test.json && node --test packages/api/dist-test/test/network-conformance.test.js
scripts.smoke:m2: npm run build && npm run smoke --workspace=@nodriver/api
scripts.smoke:native: npm run build && npm run smoke --workspace=@nodriver/runtime-native
scripts.differential: npm run build && tsc -p packages/api/tsconfig.test.json && node packages/api/dist-test/differential/run.js
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@nodriver/protocol && npm run build --workspace=@nodriver/runtime-js && npm run build --workspace=@nodriver/api && npm run build --workspace=@nodriver/runtime-native && tsc -p tsconfig.json
